subject: english
question:
Find the incorrect part of the sentence:

She is better in mathematics than English.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**better in mathematics**" is incorrect because the preposition "**in**" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• When comparing skills or abilities in two subjects, the correct preposition is "**at**" instead of "in."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**better at mathematics than English**."
 
• Therefore, the error is located in **Option 4**, which contains the incorrect preposition.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She is better at mathematics than English."*
